description: This file defines the 'Credit' controller class for the OpenCart admin extension related to 'total' modules. It manages the display and saving of the credit total configuration in the admin interface.

classes.name: Credit
classes.description: Controller class for managing the credit total extension in the admin panel of OpenCart, inheriting from the system's Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the credit total extension, including breadcrumbs, headers, and current settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the credit total extension, with permission checks and JSON response.
